posts.zh:
dsh-flomo 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。配置一次 flomo API URL / API Key，Agent 即可用 flomo_send 把笔记、摘要、待办写进 flomo（浮墨笔记）。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-b97dc49319a9b1d78fd7.html
posts.en:
dsh-flomo is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Write notes and memos to flomo (浮墨笔记) from any agent via the flomo_send tool, configured once with the flomo API URL or API Key.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-b97dc49319a9b1d78fd7.html
